sections.text: For teachers who prep their own sub plans A substitute-teaching pack that’s ready before a teacher needs a sick day. AlreadyCovered keeps a source-linked substitute packet current from the lesson files you already have, so an unplanned absence doesn’t mean rebuilding tomorrow’s lessons from scratch while you’re unwell. sections.heading: Sub plans get assembled at the worst possible moment.
sections.text: THE PROBLEM Sub plans get assembled at the worst possible moment. Most sub-plan tools still need you to gather context and assemble resources once an absence is already happening. AlreadyCovered keeps the draft current in advance, so there's less to do when you're least able to do it. Before Hunt down the right worksheet, retype routines from memory, and hope the sub can follow notes written in a hurry. During AlreadyCovered has already drafted instructions from your real files and flagged what it couldn't confirm. Now Review what's flagged, approve the materials to include, and export a packe

sections.heading: Grounded by construction, not by hope
sections.text: WHY IT WORKS THIS WAY Grounded by construction, not by hope Every claim traces to a source The model is only ever shown excerpts from your own indexed files and can only cite IDs it was actually given. Anything it cites outside that set is stripped before you ever see it. Missing means flagged, not filled in No worksheet, no safety procedure, and no lesson date is ever invented. If the material isn't there, you see an honest "needs attention" instead of a confident-sounding guess. Your corrections stick Edit a step, reject a match, or confirm a routine - your changes are preserved across regen

sections.heading: From lesson files to a finished packet
sections.text: HOW IT WORKS From lesson files to a finished packet 1 Upload your lesson files Add the worksheets and lesson notes you already have for your class. 2 Set your weekly schedule Tell AlreadyCovered your class periods once; it reuses them every week. 3 Review the draft packet See what's ready, what's missing, and exactly which file backs each instruction. 4 Export when you need it One click produces a real, printable PDF and a ZIP of the approved materials.
